design.primary_comparison: Native prompt contrast gain versus preservation release; spectral correction matched to realized UNIFORM50 per-step budget
design.external_baseline: FlowEdit n_max=26 between frozen R75 n_max=24,guidance8 and n_max=28,guidance5.5; official-default n_max24,guidance5.5 remains archived in R74

preregistration.primary: edit_ok AND subject_ok AND pattern_ok AND NOT artifact; all planned edits remain in denominator
preregistration.comparison: GAIN2/4 vs frozen T100_KV: prompt contrast. GAIN4_OFF vs GAIN4_KV: memory. SPECTRAL50 vs UNIFORM50: correction spatial frequencies at matched per-step RMS. FlowEdit N26 vs frozen N28 changes n_max only.
preregistration.budget: SPECTRAL50 consumes the matching UNIFORM50 realized RMS profile, with identical h; log per-step target, scale, applied RMS, and accumulated error. Other comparisons are not budget matched.
preregistration.cost: Standalone transformer NFE: GAIN2_KV/GAIN4_KV=98; GAIN4_OFF=84; UNIFORM50_KV/SPECTRAL50_KV=91; FLOWEDIT_N26=52. Measured counts take precedence.
preregistration.annotation: Blind edit/subject/pattern/artifact labels, unscored stays pending; no VLM credential needed.
preregistration.selection: Select global setting by joint success, then edit success and lower NFE. No task-wise cherry-picking. Confirm selected configuration on independent sources before larger benchmark.
preregistration.reporting: Native lossless PNG metrics; export compact thumbnails and scalar step summaries. Dog tasks share a source. Report task effects and uncertain judgments explicitly.

delivery.public_package: thumbnails, sheets, metrics, review, scalar step summaries and frozen reference previews
delivery.native_outputs: kept only in package/results on server
